import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

bins   = [(0,50000),(50000,75000),(75000,100000),(100000,125000),
          (125000,150000),(150000,175000),(175000,200000),(200000,250000),
          (250000,300000),(300000,400000)]
counts = [108,397,801,1184,1328,1213,859,815,296,217]

edges     = np.array([b[0] for b in bins] + [bins[-1][1]])
midpoints = (edges[:-1] + edges[1:]) / 2
mean_val  = np.average(midpoints, weights=counts)

plt.hist(edges[:-1], edges, weights=counts, color='steelblue', edgecolor='white')
plt.axvline(mean_val, color='#e74c3c', lw=2,      label=f'Mean ${mean_val:,.0f}')
plt.axvline(146_065,  color='k',       lw=2, ls='--', label='Median $146,065')
plt.xticks(edges, [f'${x/1000:.0f}k' for x in edges], rotation=45, ha='right')
plt.xlabel('Annual Salary (USD)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('./skewness.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.show()

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.datasets import fetch_openml

df = fetch_openml('heart-statlog', as_frame=True).frame

bp_no  = df[df['class']=='absent']['resting_blood_pressure'].dropna()
bp_yes = df[df['class']=='present']['resting_blood_pressure'].dropna()

q1, q2 = [np.quantile(g, np.linspace(0.01, 0.99, 100)) for g in (bp_no, bp_yes)]

plt.scatter(q1, q2, alpha=0.6, s=20)
plt.plot([q1.min(), q1.max()], [q1.min(), q1.max()], 'r--', label='No difference')
plt.xlabel('No Disease Quantiles (mmHg)')
plt.ylabel('Disease Quantiles (mmHg)')
plt.title('Q-Q: Blood Pressure — No Disease vs Disease')
plt.legend()
plt.show()

def nominal_dissimilarity(obj1, obj2):
p = len(obj1)
m = sum(1 for a, b in zip(obj1, obj2) if a == b)
return (p - m) / p
